source.implements: the lists as the app shows them (data.js, at load): each unit entry of ARMIES joined with its datasheet (DATASHEETS) into the unit the app has always had: the datasheet's columns, then the entry's own (null: none); each row the datasheet's row of that name (a stats row without its "×N"; for an attached unit the part its who or of names, else the first part that has it) with the entry row's fields on top, a row the datasheet does not have as the list's own; an entry without a kind of rows takes all of its datasheet's; over (a fact two lists have differently) on top of all; ds, over, of, faction, bsId and fingerprints hidden; keys in TABLE_ORDER; each unit its own copy of the datasheet's values. No rule is applied: verify/tables.js checks every list resolves to exactly what it was
